importantFindings: Prairie 36 is directly the predecessor to the Atlantic 37 Double Cabin after Prairie tooling was acquired in 1982.
Tollycraft 34 and 37 are modified-V planing-capable flybridge cruisers; previous semi-displacement normalization was too conservative.
Uniflite 36 II in 1984 used a materially different cored hull and revised interior, so it is represented as a production phase.
Trojan manufacturer-era numbering confirms model 363 as F-36 Tri Cabin; the explicit F-series identity supports treating the fiberglass F-36 separately from earlier wood-era Trojan identities.
Ocean Alexander 39 listing evidence frequently includes swim-grid/hull extensions, so model-wide LOA and displacement are intentionally left unresolved rather than copied from modified examples.
Nordhavn 40 and N40II are one hull lineage with a documented 2004 refinement/yard-change generation; draft and engine power are phase-scoped.
SeaPiper 35 receives strong factory dimensions, displacement, tankage and propulsion specifications.
Seahorse Coot 38 published displacement figures conflict materially; B-Atlas keeps displacement unresolved while canonicalizing steel construction and stable dimensions.
